title: Khosla Ventures is opening a New York office this fall — its first outpost outside Sand Hill Road | TechCrunch
summary: Speaking Thursday night at TechCrunch’s StrictlyVC event in New York’s West Village, Rabois confirmed that Khosla Ventures is opening its first-ever office outside Sand Hill Road. He paused, then said it depends on seniority.
